implementation.lifecycle: Explicit foreground invocation; process exits on Ctrl-C/SIGTERM; no Runit/Termux:Boot integration
implementation.bootstrap: Generate one 256-bit URL-safe secret per run in memory; show only on an interactive stderr TTY; never save to file or environment; bootstrap is one-use
implementation.authorization: Read-only reviewed scopes only; module invariant rejects overlap with operation mutation capabilities
implementation.mutations: Disabled in the foreground runtime; no durable store is configured for mutation dispatch
implementation.native_boundary: Requires Termux PREFIX and TERMUX_VERSION environment markers plus HOME

tests.management_security_focused_command: python3 -m unittest tests.test_management_http_runtime tests.test_management_http_server tests.test_management_request_store tests.test_management_http_adapter tests.test_management_request_policy tests.test_management_sessions tests.test_management_authorization -q

limitations: This command was not invoked to start a persistent listener; only the fixture test used an ephemeral port and closed it.
No browser UI/client provisioning, device fixed-port qualification, or off-home private transport is integrated.
No boot/service-manager integration exists; the user must run the command in a foreground terminal.
The one-use bootstrap must be reissued by restarting the foreground server after session establishment; active sessions are memory-only.
Read-only scope selection does not qualify any guest or Android ownership; it only routes through the existing bounded application API.
